info: Plan E (new). Living room follows your screenshot: three modular seats along the window, a sofa on each side, a round travertine coffee table and an angled corner TV wall: the TV sits on a marble panel above a floating walnut console, with full-height cabinets behind it, reached through the doors at both ends and the flap doors above (deep corner storage). It is fixed to the west wall and stands 50 mm off the shelter wall – nothing fixed to the shelter. Entrance half-glass partition as in Plan B. Dining moves outside the kitchen, so Plan A's study room is dropped; bedroom 3 keeps Plan A's two options (queen bed or 2 standing desks – see the option menu). Everything else follows Plan A. Kitchen: closed or open with bi-fold glass; removing the kitchen front wall must be confirmed with HDB / your ID. Power points and trunking are indicative.
